Ingredients:
â¢ 4 large strawberries
â¢ 4 tablespoons strained (Greek) yogurt

Method:
1.	First, add 4 large strawberries to a bowl and mash them well until they reach a smooth, soft consistency.

2.	Add 4 tablespoons of Greek yogurt and 1 tablespoon of chia seeds on top.

3.	Add about 1 teaspoon of honey and mix everything together until well combined.

4.	Set the strawberry pudding mixture aside for a few minutes to rest.

5.	Meanwhile, slice the banana.

6.	Bring the bowl back and start decorating: place the banana slices along the edges.

7.	Add a line of shredded coconut down the center and place your homemade granola on the other side.

8.	Add a few fresh mint leaves for a pop of color and a touch of aesthetics.

9.	Finally, drizzle 1 teaspoon of honey over the top and enjoy!
